lines.zh: 我在黑水里游，蓝光拖着。
lines.en: I swim through black water, dragging blue light.
Each time my jaw shifts, I click.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有底，也没有顶。
lines.en: Here there is no bottom and no top.

lines.zh: 我的蓝光在水里划开一道痕。
lines.en: My blue glow cuts a line through the dark.

lines.zh: 那些锯齿牙从嘴里露着。
lines.en: My saw teeth show even with my mouth shut.

lines.zh: 我游得很快，追得上落水的东西。
lines.en: I swim fast enough to catch whatever falls.
In this dark, only my color shows.
I cruise along the edge of the void.
The current here breaks off in places.

lines.zh: 我张口，试了试牙的锋利。
lines.en: I open up and test how sharp they are.
I never school; there is only me.
A flash of blue, and I sink again.
I can bite through the hardest scales.

lines.zh: 前面什么都没有，我还是游。
lines.en: Nothing lies ahead, and still I swim.

lines.zh: 我绕过沉下来的石头，继续游。
lines.en: I swim around the fallen stone and keep going.

lines.zh: 蓝光在身后拖出一条细线。
lines.en: Blue light trails a thin line behind me.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，钻过缝。
lines.en: I turn on my side and slip through the gap.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，牙却一直张着。
lines.en: I swim slowly, teeth always parted.

lines.zh: 我停在黑水里，光还亮着。
lines.en: I hang in the black water, still glowing.
My jaw clicks once, then goes still.
There is no other sound down here.
I close my teeth and grind them slowly.
The void's water does not move at all.
My blue light falls on nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我侧身悬着，等东西落水。
lines.en: I lie on my side and wait for a splash.
Nothing is here, and that is enough.
My fins barely move at all.
The black water is quieter than I expected.
I narrow my eyes and the glow weakens.

lines.zh: 牙缝里还留着旧鳞的渣。
lines.en: Old scale bits still stick between my teeth.
I open my mouth and slowly close it.
The darkness puts me completely at ease.

lines.zh: 你从上面掉下来，我看见了。
lines.en: You fall in from above, and I see you.
My blue glow lights up your face.
You should not be down here at all.
I rise slowly until I face you.
Did you see my teeth just now?

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，蓝光一圈圈。
lines.en: I circle you, leaving rings of blue.
Your breath comes out in bubbles.
I take my time and judge your size.
The light in your hand is dimmer than mine.
I stop one arm's length away from you.
I bite down on my own jaw.
My blue light shudders and dims.
I tumble one way, then the other.
In black water the blood does not show.
I shake my head and my teeth clatter.
The pain makes me clench and hold.
I retreat into the darker depths.
My fins tremble, and so does my light.
That one will stay with me a long while.
I snap at nothing and hit nothing.
Something in your hand is shining.
I have tasted that smell once before.
I come close and my teeth show first.
You push the thing a little toward me.
I circle once and come back for it.
This is not enough to wear my teeth on.
I open my mouth and do not bite yet.
You step back and I stop at once.
I do not trust you, but I trust food.
Give me another one, and be quick.
You bump me and I hold my teeth back.

lines.zh: 我的蓝光在你甲上滑开。
lines.en: My light slides across your armor.
The bucket walls are too bright for me.
Your hand touches me and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 黑水被我们搅出一片光。
lines.en: Our tangle stirs a patch of blue light.
The knock rolls me over once.
I swim off and look at you from the side.
The iron smell on you is too strong.
My teeth graze the edge of your boot.
The light in the water stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 这片水里从没别的同类。
lines.en: No other of my kind has ever been here.
I part my jaw; nothing comes out.

lines.zh: 我游了很久，蓝光都暗了。
lines.en: I swim so long my blue glow fades.

lines.zh: 如果有同类，她会咬我一口。
lines.en: If one came, she would bite me first.
I grind my teeth and wait for an answer.
The void is too large; nothing echoes back.

lines.zh: 我从来没有被钓上来过两次。
lines.en: I have never been hooked up twice.
The light spreads out, then pulls back.
I keep this stretch of black alone.

lines.zh: 同伴这东西，我大概不会有。
lines.en: A mate, I suppose, is not for me.

lines.zh: 我用牙咬住落下的东西。
lines.en: I catch the falling thing in my teeth.
It gives a little when I bite down.

lines.zh: 我把牙合上，听那声脆响。
lines.en: I close my teeth and hear it crack.
The skin on this thing is tough.
I haul it around in a slow circle.
It slides through the gap in my teeth.
I bite off a piece and keep it.
The rest I cannot be bothered with.
My teeth can bite straight through tin.

lines.zh: 每次捡东西都掉几颗牙渣。
lines.en: Every pickup leaves a few tooth bits behind.
The surface breaks and I look up.
Something is sinking toward me.
I catch the smell of blood, faint.
Its fins are moving and I have seen it.
I hold still and part my teeth first.
That outline does not look like a fish.

lines.zh: 我锁定了它下沉的路线。
lines.en: I lock onto the line it is sinking along.
My blue shows clearest in the dark.
Its shadow is coming toward me.
I straighten my body and aim at it.
I come up from below, very slowly.
It has not seen my blue glow yet.
I measure the distance, then bite.

lines.zh: 它稍微一动，我就跟着偏。
lines.en: Each small shift of its body, I match.
I fix on the thinnest part of it.
My teeth are open as wide as they go.
It is panicking and its movement turns ragged.
My glow is the only light it has.
Half a foot closer and I snap shut.
I make no sound as I close in.
My teeth close with a sharp crack.
I bite clean through its scales.

lines.zh: 它挣开，我留下一道口子。
lines.en: It tears free, leaving a gash behind.
I lunge again and hold on tight.

lines.zh: 蓝光乱闪，血在水里散开。
lines.en: My light flickers as blood clouds the water.
It rams me and my teeth stay locked.
I twist around and bite again.

lines.zh: 这么小的嘴，咬得这么深。
lines.en: Such a small mouth, biting so deep.
It sinks, and I follow it down.
When it is done, I grind my teeth.

lines.zh: 钓线把我从黑水里拉出来。
lines.en: A fishing line pulls me out of the black.

lines.zh: 我从没在这片水里出生。
lines.en: I was never born in this water.
Light falls on me for the first time.
I open up and bite at the air.

lines.zh: 这里的黑比钓鱼的水更黑。
lines.en: This black is darker than where I was hooked.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己从哪片水里来。
lines.en: I have no memory of any birthplace.
My teeth gleam as soon as they leave water.
I am set down and swim into the deep.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次有自己的地方。
lines.en: This is the first place that is mine.
My blue light comes alive in the dark.
How can there be fire in the water?
I keep falling with my teeth clenched.
Even here I manage to choke.
The blast shoves me a long way off.

lines.zh: 有个东西扎进我的侧身。
lines.en: Something has sunk into my side.
A spell leaves my teeth cold.
There is nothing in the black to bite.
Lightning runs through the water and I go numb.
Even the black water is gone now.
